title: Genesis 4:14 — “I shall be hidden… a fugitive and a vagabond”
summary: Genesis 4:14 in English and Hebrew: Cain says God has driven him from the face of the ground, he will be hidden from God’s face and be a fugitive and vagabond, and anyone who finds him will kill him.

text.text: 14 Surely You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground; and from your face I shall be hidden; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond on the earth, and it will happen that anyone who finds me will kill me.”
14 הן גרשת אתי היום מעל פני האדמה ומפניך אסתר והייתי נע ונד בארץ והיה כל מצאי יהרגני׃

keywords: from thy face shall I be hid
every one that findeth me shall slay me
